actions.title: START all services
actions.summary: Starts every down listener with no extra console windows. Same as the START shortcut.
actions.detail: Calls Start-ChicagoShiningHiddenAll.ps1. Already-up ports are skipped. cloudflared is not started here; that Windows service must already be running for public hostnames.

actions.title: STOP all services
actions.summary: Stops the local listeners (ports 3011–3360). Leaves this dashboard and cloudflared running so you can start again.
actions.detail: Runs the stock 99-stop helper. Does not stop cloudflared and does not stop the Ops Dashboard on :3361.

actions.title: VERIFY health
actions.summary: Checks local and public /health the same way the VERIFY shortcut does.
actions.detail: Runs verify-chicagoshining-local-services.ps1. A green VERIFY means listeners and Cloudflare routes answer; it does not mean new Git code is in Services\.

actions.title: DESK companion (probe)
actions.summary: Read-only public /health probe plus git drift. Does not restart or deploy.
actions.detail: Invoke-DeskCompanion.ps1 with no -RestartDown. Use this first when something looks down.

actions.title: DESK companion (restart down)
actions.summary: Probe, then hidden-start one down service when Desk mode is infra or higher.
actions.detail: Invoke-DeskCompanion.ps1 -RestartDown. Will not deploy. Mode below infra only reports.

actions.title: Close orphan consoles
actions.summary: Closes leftover Chicago Shining PowerShell windows that are not actually listening.
actions.detail: Close-OrphanChicagoShiningConsoles.ps1. Keeps any process that still owns a listen port.

actions.title: Start one service
actions.summary: Hidden-start a single listener if its port is down.
actions.detail: Start-ChicagoShiningHidden.ps1 -Service <id>. Skips when the port is already listening.

actions.title: Restart one service
actions.summary: Stop the port, then hidden-start that service again.
actions.detail: Start-ChicagoShiningHidden.ps1 -Service <id> -StopFirst. Use after OAuth or .env changes on YouTube uploaders.

actions.title: Stop one service
actions.summary: Stop the listener on that service's port.
actions.detail: Uses the same port-guard stop as DEPLOY. Refuses to stop this dashboard from its own Stop one control (use the Windows process or close the app).

actions.title: SYNC Git checkout
actions.summary: Fast-forward SM-Pipeline-V2 to origin/main. Does not copy into Services\ or restart anything.
actions.detail: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main. Dirty or diverged checkouts fail; it never reset --hard.

actions.title: PLAN deploy
actions.summary: Read-only plan: which files would change from origin/main. No production mutation.
actions.detail: Deploy-SMService.ps1 -Service <id> -PlanOnly -Yes. Video Compressor and Task Organizer are not in this selector.

actions.title: DEPLOY service
actions.summary: Copy approved origin/main into the live Services folder for one service, then restart and health-check.
actions.detail: Deploy-SMService.ps1 -Service <id> -Yes. Preserves .env and runtime data. First-install can create the live folder. Public /health is required except where the service marks it optional (Timing Engine, this dashboard until the tunnel hostname exists).

actions.title: DEPLOY Pipeline Runner
actions.summary: Same as DEPLOY with pipeline-runner preselected. VERIFY health alone does not ship new Flask routes.

actions.title: ROLLBACK latest deploy
actions.summary: Restore the newest local backup for that service and restart it.
actions.detail: Deploy-SMService.ps1 -Service <id> -RollbackLatest -Yes. Fails if no backup exists.
